title: What You Observe Determines How You Identify Causal Effects: Evaluating Causal Models across Observational Views
abstract: arXiv:2609.36881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal foundation models (CFMs) pre-trained on data generated from various structural causal models (SCMs) have been proposed for estimating causal effects from observational data. However, differences in pre-training environments and evaluation protocols make it difficult to assess how their performance depends on the information available for causal identification. To enable controlled comparisons, we introduce CausalIDView, a multi-view benchmark that holds fixed SCM realization and target estimand while varying only the observational view available to the estimator. Each observational view corresponds to a distinct identification regime under the benchmark's maintained causal assumptions. Across these matched views, no CFM consistently performs best and model rankings vary substantially. Under controlled structural changes, CFMs exhibit model-specific failures to maintain stable estimates when true effects are unchanged and to track

translated_title: 你观察到什么决定了你如何识别因果效应：跨观察视角评估因果模型
translated_abstract: 因果基础模型（CFMs）是在由多种结构因果模型（SCMs）生成的数据上进行预训练的模型，被提出用于从观察数据中估计因果效应。然而，预训练环境和评估协议的差异使得难以评估其性能如何依赖于可用于因果识别的信息。为了实现受控比较，我们引入了CausalIDView，这是一个多视角基准，它在保持SCM实现和目标估计量固定不变的情况下，仅改变估计器可用的观察视角。在该基准所维护的因果假设下，每个观察视角都对应一种不同的识别机制。在这些匹配的视角下，没有任何一个CFM能始终表现最佳，且模型排名差异显著。在受控的结构变化下，CFMs表现出模型特有的失败模式：当真实效应不变时无法维持稳定的估计值，也无法追踪……
tldr: 该论文提出了多视角基准CausalIDView，通过固定结构因果模型与目标估计量、仅改变可观察视角的方式，受控评估因果基础模型在不同识别情形下的表现，发现没有任何模型能够始终表现最佳。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CausalIDView, a multi-view benchmark that evaluates causal foundation models by holding the SCM realization and target estimand fixed while varying only the observational view, revealing that no CFM consistently performs best across identification regimes.
